title: JSON as a Pure Content Engine
subtitle: Why static, portable JSON schemas remain the ultimate format for long-term digital archivism.
summary: Database abstractions come and go, but clean JSON files outlast frameworks. A look at structuring resilient document schemas for blog platforms.

content.text: In an era dominated by headless CMS platforms, cloud databases, and complex GraphQL layers, the simplicity of a raw JSON document remains unmatched for portability, security, and instantaneous rendering.

content.caption: Figure 2.1: A minimalist developer workspace optimized for focus and raw code parsing.

content.text: The Anatomy of a Clean Post Schema
A blog post JSON document should be self-contained, typed, and structured around semantically decoupled content blocks rather than fragile inline HTML markup.
This structured block approach allows frontend clients in Svelte, React, Vue, or terminal CLI parsers to render the content natively without unsafe innerHTML vulnerability vectors.
Data formats should outlive the code written to parse them.
